moworks.notes: Idea and numbers (TakayuStudio drag-resistance, written here): Grab the right edge: it moves +92 px in 600 ms power2.inOut while the left edge lags (follows 100 ms later, width kept within 80–108 px: scaleX up to 1.35, height 1/scaleX); release: the pill springs back (k 220, d 16) ~12 px past its slot and settles, stretching up to +18 % with speed on the way. Params: pull (92 px) · lag: trễ mép sau (0.1 s) · stretch max (1.35) · spring (k 220, d 16).
